children: iQSTEL reported unauthorized access affecting GlobeTopper’s platform, which disrupted operations and led to an estimated high-end $2.5 million in revenue not generated.
GlobeTopper rebuilt its platform and cloud environment, resuming commercial operations in stages beginning November 1.
The incident disrupted fourth-quarter 2026 transaction volume; some interrupted revenue may be deferred or recovered, and permanent losses are undetermined.
Approximately $70,000 in digital gift cards were redeemed without authorization; iQSTEL expects to bear the loss, subject to potential recovery.
Exposed customer API credentials and integration keys were revoked and rotated; the investigation continues, and iQSTEL has not determined the incident to be material.

title: iQSTEL Reports GlobeTopper Cyber Incident, Estimates Up to $2.5 Million in Revenue Not Generated
